why: The chapter names Peter; Bible Atlas files him under his first name, Simon (id simon, as in content/atlas/Act.json).
The chapter's quotation from Ezekiel names Noah, Job and Daniel, and Bible Atlas links the other two but not Job.

Corinth appears only in the closing title line, 'The second letter of Clement to the Corinthians', added by a later copyist. The sermon itself names no place, and its first audience is a matter of debate.
